SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp <= (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders);

SELECT 
    order_status, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    order_status;

SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.price) AS toplam_ciro
FROM 
  orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS ay,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  ay;

SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english AS kategori_adi,
    SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (MAX(order_delivered_customer_date) - MAX(order_purchase_timestamp))) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS geri_teslim_orani
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    customers.customer_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM 
    customers
JOIN 
    orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    customers.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    musteri_sayisi DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  payment_type, 
  SUM(payment_value) AS toplam_odenen
FROM 
  order_payments
JOIN 
  orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
  payment_type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id)
FROM orders
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE;

SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS ortalama_degerlendirme_puani
FROM 
  order_reviews
JOIN 
  orders ON order_reviews.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id)
FROM sellers;

SELECT MAX(price) AS en_pahalı_fiyat
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id) AS satici_sayisi
FROM 
    sellers
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_state;

SELECT 
  review_score,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM 
  order_reviews
WHERE 
  order_reviews.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  review_score
ORDER BY 
  review_score;

SELECT 
  payment_installments, 
  COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM 
  order_payments
JOIN 
  orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE 
  payment_type = 'credit_card'
  AND order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
  payment_installments
ORDER BY 
  frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COALESCE(CAST(c.customer_city AS TEXT), 'Bilinmeyen Şehir') AS customer_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    customer_city
ORDER BY 
    siparis_sayisi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    geolocation_state AS eyalet,
    ROUND(SUM(order_items.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id), 2) AS ortalama_siparis_tutari
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
JOIN 
    geolocation ON customers.customer_zip_code_prefix = geolocation.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    geolocation_state
ORDER BY 
    ortalama_siparis_tutari DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_id,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers ON order_items.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_id
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS ay,
  SUM(order_items.price) AS ciro
FROM
  orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE
  orders.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
GROUP BY
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY
  ay;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS hafta_gunu,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int
ORDER BY 
    siparis_sayisi DESC;

SELECT 
    DISTINCT customer_state, 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) AS teslimat_suresi
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY 
    teslimat_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customers.customer_unique_id) >= 2 THEN customers.customer_unique_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS tekrar_eden_musteri_orani
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';
